svg.text: Why Reranking Exists
Bridges the gap between coarse recall and deep model precision
• Initial retrieval extracts large candidate pools (50+) to secure recall
• Passing unpruned lists wastes token context and dilutes key information
• Prevents "lost-in-the-middle" behavior where LLMs miss mid-context details
The Reranking Spectrum
Tradeoff curve moving from high speed to extreme semantic accuracy
• Score-Based: Filters raw retrieval scores directly (fastest, lowest quality)
• Late Interaction (ColBERT): Medium cost with strong operational quality
• Cross-Encoders & LLM Judges: Highest practical precision (slowest execution)
Score-Based Reranking
Simplistic filtering using numerical weights from initial retrieval cycles
• Threshold Filtering: Drops elements failing a minimum baseline target
• Vector Pitfall: High similarity scores don't guarantee exact context relevance
• Keyword Flaw: BM25 scores are unbounded; scales break across distinct corpora
Cross-Encoder Mechanics
Input Format: [CLS] query_tokens [SEP] chunk_tokens [SEP]
• Complete Interaction: Tokens attend to each other across all model layers
• Core Lift: Consistently beats isolated bi-encoders by 10 to 20 NDCG points
• Operational Cost: Requires GPU forward pass per candidate pair at runtime
Strategies for Long Chunks
Overcomes rigid context constraints (e.g., 512-token BERT limits)
• Sliding Window: Breaks text into overlapping parts; records maximum score
• First-N Tokens: Simple, immediate truncation technique for front-loaded text
Risk: Truncation completely drops relevant terms hiding deep in trailing paragraphs
Reranker Model Selection
• MiniLM-L-6-v2 (22M): Ultra-fast performance; ideal production baseline
• MiniLM-L-12-v2 (33M): Gains ~3 MRR points but doubles computation latency
• BGE-Reranker-v2-m3 (568M): SOTA multilingual capability; requires heavy GPU
• Cohere v3 / Voyage v2: Elite managed APIs; great for specialized tech text
LLM-Based Reranking
• Pointwise: Evaluates chunks individually (0-10 scale); highly slow/costly
• Listwise: Processes and ranks multiple text candidates inside a single prompt
• RankGPT: Sliding window permutation sort; provides premium quality results
Best For: Offline golden dataset generation or ultra high-stakes reasoning pipelines
Diversity-Aware Reranking (MMR)
MMR = L * Sim(Di, Q) - (1 - L) * Max_Sim(Di, Dj)
• Goal: Prevents filling context windows with redundant text variations
• Lambda Balance: 1.0 is pure semantic relevance; 0.0 is pure variation
• Use Case: Crucial for multi-part synthesis and broad comparison queries
Contextual Compression
Prunes text structures to squeeze out fluff before language model synthesis
• LLM Extraction: Isolates precise relevant sentences; premium latency fee
• Sentence-Level Vectors: Strips out rows falling below basic cosine floors
Benefit: Drops a 500-token chunk to 50 vital words, freeing up reasoning space
Pipeline Latency & Fine-Tuning
• Budget Allocation: Aim for under 100ms for retrieval + cross-encoder cycles
• Real-time Bounds: MiniLM takes ~30ms on GPU; LLM rerankers blow budgets
• Fine-Tuning: 1k to 5k domain pairs lift localized precision by 5 to 15 percent
Evaluation Metric: Reranking must lift Precision@10 while holding Recall@50
